name.description: Human-readable profile name shown in the UI.

description.description: One or two sentence summary shown alongside the name.

version.description: Schema/profile revision, bumped on breaking changes to this profile's definition.

host_packages.description: Packages installed on the host system itself (e.g. git, podman).

environment.description: Container-based dev environment definition (Podman/Distrobox), not applied to the host.

setup.description: Named setup steps run inside the container (e.g. 'install-java-25').

checks.description: Commands used to verify the profile applied correctly (e.g. 'git --version').
